# Isaiah Chapter 25 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 12 verses]*

*Thanksgiving; feast of rich food; death swallowed; tears wiped; Moab humbled*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 25 (Praise for God's Deliverance) addresses thanksgiving; feast of rich food; death swallowed; tears wiped; moab humbled. The key verse — "He will swallow up death forever, and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
